items.title: The Jury Selection
items.premise: Location: Courtroom. Judge: "Are you impartial?" Juror: "I don't know anyone here." Judge: "Good. The defendant?" Juror: "My twin brother." Judge stares blankly. Silent reaction beat.

items.title: The DMV Appointment
items.premise: Location: Customer Service. Clerk: "Next in line." Customer: "I have an appointment." Clerk: "For when?" Customer: "Three years ago." Clerk: "You are five minutes early." Customer blinks silently.

items.title: The Park Bench
items.premise: Location: Park. Stranger A: "Nice day today." Stranger B: "I am invisible." Stranger A: "I can see you." Stranger B: "Then the spell failed." Stranger A slowly looks away. Silent reaction beat.

items.title: Fake Spaghetti
items.premise: Dad: "Hey kid, what do you call a fake noodle?" Teen: "Please don't." Dad: "An impasta!" Teen groans and covers face. Dad winks at camera.

items.title: Elevator Skill
items.premise: Dad: "My job at the elevator company is amazing." Teen: "Why?" Dad: "It has its ups and downs!" Teen walks out of frame in silence while Dad chuckles.

items.title: The Musical Bike
items.premise: Bicycle Host: "Why couldn't the bicycle stand up by itself?" Pedestrian: "Why?" Bicycle Host: "Because it was two-tired!" Pedestrian shakes head in disappointment.

items.title: The Calendar's Days
items.premise: Planner: "Why is the calendar always nervous?" Calendar: "Because my days are numbered!" Planner stares at the calendar in disbelief.

items.title: POV: Finding the Mug
items.premise: Me: "Where is my coffee?" Brain: "Check the fridge." Me opens fridge, finds coffee next to the milk. Me: "Why did we put it there?" Brain: "It felt safe." Me takes a cold sip in defeat.

items.title: The Online Order Confidence
items.premise: Me: "I bought clothes online without checking the size chart." Package arrives. Me tries on shirt: it fits like a doll shirt. Me: "I am now a stylish fashion model for ants."

items.title: The Heavy Feather
items.premise: Riddle Master: "What gets wetter the more it dries?" Contestant: "A sponge?" Riddle Master: "A towel!" Contestant blinks: "Wait... that actually makes total sense."

items.title: The Building Mystery
items.premise: Riddle Master: "What has many keys but can't open a single lock?" Contestant: "A key ring?" Riddle Master: "A piano!" Contestant slowly air-pianos in defeat.

items.title: The Camera-On Panic
items.premise: Boss: "Let's all turn on our cameras for a quick photo!" Employee (wearing pajamas with a formal shirt taped to front): "My camera just broke, sir!" Boss: "We can see your shirt slipping." Employee freezes.

items.title: Friday at 4:58 PM
items.premise: Worker packing bag at 4:58 PM. Co-worker: "Did you check Slack?" Worker: "I cannot read after 4:55 PM, it's medical." Co-worker approves and nods silently.

items.title: NPC In Real Life
items.premise: Player walks up to friend. Friend repeats the same dialogue while walking into a wall: "Good morning! Fine weather today!" Player: "Are you bugged?" Friend: "Good morning! Fine weather today!" Player slowly walks backwards away.

items.title: Very Demure Water Break
items.premise: Influencer takes a tiny sip from a massive 1-gallon water bottle with pinky out: "Very mindful, very demure." Friend: "You've been holding that bottle for 2 hours and took 1 milliliter." Influencer winks silently.
